ethics_check.summary_text: All papers that appeared to involve live data collection contained an ethics approval statement.

table.text: The institutional review boards at Rutgers State University (Pro2022000949) and the UBTH, Benin City (ADM/E22/A/VOL.
University of Pennsylvania and Duke University relied on Rutgers and UBTH for IRB oversight.
All procedures involving human participants were conducted in accordance with relevant ethical guidelines and regulations, including the Declaration of Helsinki and its later amendments.
Data may be made available upon reasonable request to the corresponding author, contingent on institutional review board approval and completion of appropriate data use agreements.
Between October 2022 and May 2023, youth aged 9-18 years and their mothers were enrolled and subsequently followed across four study visits.
Written informed consent was obtained from a parent or legal guardian for each minor, and written assent from each youth, before recruitment.
Additional verbal consent was obtained for blood and oral sample collection beyond the written consent and assent provided at the visit.

Research staff delivered standardized written and verbal explanations of study procedures, risks, and benefits, and individuals who expressed interest and met eligibility criteria were enrolled and retained for longitudinal follow-up.
All procedures involving human participants were conducted in accordance with relevant ethical guidelines and regulations, including the Declaration of Helsinki and its later amendments.
At each visit, participants provided a 10mL saline oral rinse, which was centrifuged at 2000g for 15mins to pellet and resuspended in 4.5mL of the rinse, aliquoted and stored at -80°C. 24
table.formatted: At each visit, participants provided a 10mL saline oral rinse, which was centrifuged at 2000g for 15mins to pellet and resuspended in 4.5mL of the rinse, aliquoted and stored at -80°C. <ref type="bibr" target="#b23">24</ref>

table.text: Beyond HIV status, persistent and transient participants were broadly similar in age, education, oral-health indices, and behavioral exposures.

In the HPV Infections in Men (HIM) cohort, most oral infections cleared and long-term persistence of even HPV16 was rare 38 ; in a seven-year HIV-affected cohort, 97% of incident and 71% of prevalent oral infections had cleared by the end of follow-up. 7 Only three participants were positive at all four visits, and that estimates were stable whether we required the same genotype or restricted to later visits, indicates that the small, persistent fraction is a genuine feature of the data rather than an artifact of any single definition.

ethics_check.report:
Based on the following text, we would expect an ethics approval statement, and it was present:

> Between October 2022 and May 2023, youth aged 9-18 years and their mothers were enrolled and subsequently followed across four study visits.

> Written informed consent was obtained from a parent or legal guardian for each minor, and written assent from each youth, before recruitment.

> Additional verbal consent was obtained for blood and oral sample collection beyond the written consent and assent provided at the visit.

> Research staff delivered standardized written and verbal explanations of study procedures, risks, and benefits, and individuals who expressed interest and met eligibility criteria were enrolled and retained for longitudinal follow-up.

> All procedures involving human participants were conducted in accordance with relevant ethical guidelines and regulations, including the Declaration of Helsinki and its later amendments.

> At each visit, participants provided a 10mL saline oral rinse, which was centrifuged at 2000g for 15mins to pellet and resuspended in 4.5mL of the rinse, aliquoted and stored at -80°C. 24

> Beyond HIV status, persistent and transient participants were broadly similar in age, education, oral-health indices, and behavioral exposures.

> In the HPV Infections in Men (HIM) cohort, most oral infections cleared and long-term persistence of even HPV16 was rare 38 ; in a seven-year HIV-affected cohort, 97% of incident and 71% of prevalent oral infections had cleared by the end of follow-up. 7 Only three participants were positive at all four visits, and that estimates were stable whether we required the same genotype or restricted to later visits, indicates that the small, persistent fraction is a genuine feature of the data rather than an artifact of any single definition.

power.title: Power Analysis Check

table.text: Recruitment was carried out by trained healthcare professionals who approached eligible mother-youth dyads during routine clinic visits, enrolling consecutively presenting pairs. Written informed consent was obtained from a parent or legal guardian for each minor, and written assent from each youth, before recruitment. Additional verbal consent was obtained for blood and oral sample collection beyond the written consent and assent provided at the visit. Research staff delivered standardized written and verbal explanations of study procedures, risks, and benefits, and individuals who expressed interest and met eligibility criteria were enrolled and retained for longitudinal follow-up. The institutional review boards at Rutgers State University (Pro2022000949) and the UBTH, Benin City (ADM/E22/A/VOL. VII/14813674), Nigeria, approved this study and will be informed of the study findings in a timely manner. University of Pennsylvania and Duke University relied on Rutgers and UBTH for IRB oversight. All procedures involving human participants were conducted in accordance with relevant ethical guidelines and regulations, including the Declaration of Helsinki and its later amendments. To account for an anticipated 15% loss to follow-up, targeted enrollment was 230 youth-mother pairs in each group (n=690), stratified by HIV exposure and infection status, with HUU participants serving as the reference for comparisons. Assuming an attrition-adjusted cohort of approximately 600 participants, we estimated 80% power to detect incidence rate ratios (IRR) of approximately 1.19 or higher via Poisson regression (α=0.05, two-sided). Power was expected to remain adequate for IRRs of approximately 1.20 after adjustment for additional covariates.

table.expanded: Mother-youth genotype concordance exceeded chance (permutation p =0.009).

Persistence was concentrated among PLWH, the four-category classification differed by maternal HIV status (Fisher exact p=0.02) and by youth HIV exposure (p=0.04), and all nine persistent mothers and eight of twelve persistent youth were living with HIV.
